league_run_note: Fourth room. a1/a2 used League party v2 (326's manifest; a2 with leads reordered, party_league96_v2_drake_leads.json) and both lost: Chi-Yu and Rillaboom are resisted by all six Dragons, Xerneas enters at L84 under the legend penalty and never got a second turn, Raging Bolt at 178 Speed never moved before a Dragon Claw. Rebuilt to v3 (Kangaskhan-Mega/Whimsicott/Iron Bundle/Kingambit/Incineroar/Raging Bolt) - no box legends, Prankster Tailwind + Scrappy Fake Out opening. a3 (v3) was 4-1 up at turn 9 when the coordinator's session-limit resume voided every run dir without a receipt; a3/VOID.json records it and it is not counted. a4 (v3, fresh seed) won 6-2. Whimsicott Moonblast 10/16 and Tailwind 14/16 PP are the carry costs into Wallace.

ai_defects.description: Second authored Mega (Dragonite, mega_slots 1,6) never fires after Salamence Mega Evolves - same root cause as 325 defect 1 (position-marked HasTrainerUsedGimmick gating src/battle_controllers.c:3304).

a3 T4 and a4 T4: with Zekrom at full HP and both my attacks (Double-Edge, Moonblast) selected into Zekrom's slot, the AI hard-switched Zekrom out for Dragonite, its Mega-slot ace, which took both hits on entry (Multiscale halved one) and fainted without acting. Better: keep Zekrom (it resists neither, but a switch only helps if the incoming Pokemon resists the attacks; Dragonite is 2x weak to Moonblast). BUILD-12 UPDATE: reproduced again in a5 T4 (Dragonite entered at 2 HP thanks to Multiscale and died to Moonblast T5). Not fixed by build-12.

Zekrom used Protect on its entry turn at full HP with no incoming attack aimed at it (a3 T3, a4 T3) and again two turns later (a3 T5, a4 T5) - four empty Protects across two runs, and each one handed Whimsicott a free Prankster Encore lock. Protect at full HP on entry, beside a partner already Protecting, is the make-or-break cadence the September 15 decision calls out. BUILD-12 UPDATE: Zekrom's empty entry Protects reproduced in a5 T3 and T6.

a4: the state reading showed Zekrom's item as ITEM_GOLISOPITE from its entry onward while the engine printed the Clear Amulet message on Incineroar's Intimidate (T6). a1/a2 read CLEAR_AMULET correctly. Item field read glitch for a battler that entered mid-battle.

calibration: Build-8: lost twice with the wrong party, won 6-2 with v3. Build-12 replay with v3: won 6-3. Keep all offsets.
cooler: Already very cool: the Protect + Earthquake partnership actually fired, Koraidon's sun feeds Reshiram, and the AI's Reshiram Protect reads were sharp. It would be cooler if Dragonite actually Mega Evolved (engine defect) and if the AI never switched the Mega ace into a double-target. Consider Clear Amulet Zekrom giving way to a Sitrus/Lum item if empty Protects persist - the amulet only mattered once (Incineroar's Intimidate).
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
step_up: Yes - a clear step above Glacia. Every member OHKOs something on a standard League party (Blue Flare/Earth Power, Bolt Strike, Collision Course, Dragon Energy, Aerilate Double-Edge), and two full attempts with a Glacia-winning party ended 3-6. Only a party built around Fairy + Ice + Tailwind wins it.
